blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutor, Manila Rep. Joel Chua questioned the sincerity of Vice President Sara Duterte’s defense team’s complaints over the withdrawal of the articles on confidential funds, bribery, and grave threats, saying that while the issue of reconsideration was raised during the proceedings, the defense did not ask the court to treat its manifestation as a motion for reconsideration. The Vice President’s legal team appears to be airing objections for public consumption only rather than formally seeking reconsideration of the Senate impeachment court’s ruling that allowed the withdrawal of three impeachment articles against her, Chua said. “Di ba?
